source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: A stray handwritten mark over Question 7 2) on the scan is ignored. Scanned school paper with no text layer (only the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2025 is taken from the file name (...-070325-2025) and the icseboard.org folder. Printed header: GRADE- VI, GEOGRAPHY, ASSESSMENT-II, M.M-80, TIME-2 HOUR. Part I groups print one mark total (5) for five items, so each item is recorded as 1 mark (SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS). Question 7 3) has its (5) printed on the same line as the 'Question 8.' heading in the scan; it belongs to Q7 (Q7 then totals 10 like Q4-Q6). Questions on energy (hydroelectricity, solar panel and windmill) have no matching class-6 geography chapter and are left unmapped. The paper's own spellings (e.g. 'Amzaon', 'Which`is') are kept.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
